description: The application form of one posting from find_jobs, read live from its board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, Teamtailor, BambooHR, Pinpoint, Rippling, Bending Spoons and Eightfold; for Workday, whose form needs the person's account, the posting and Workday's standard steps, also when a Phenom career site leads to it; for SmartRecruiters, the posting only; for SuccessFactors (Capgemini too) and Amazon, the posting and account_required, since their form is shown after sign-in; for careers sites with schema.org JobPosting, the posting; other boards are read in the browser): each question with its type, options, whether it is required, the most characters the board takes (max_length) when it says, and who answers it (person or agent), the posting text marked as untrusted, and the URL to apply at.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the goal in general terms, and refer to people by role ("a candidate") rather than by name. Leave out personal and identifying information.

id.description: A job id from find_jobs, e.g. greenhouse:cabify:1234567.
